entities.name: Cadric
entities.description: A dwarf echomage on Dominaria who makes magical copies of living beings to fight beside him.

entities.name: Karplusan Mountains
entities.description: Mountains beneath which Cadric seeks a mysterious frequency.

entities.name: First Song
entities.description: Dominaria's First Song, which Cadric believes is entombed underground.
